about: The text of the gated MCU images told by who owns it (scripts/lib/text_owner_gate.py, docs/text-ownership.md). Each row holds the image's text and the bytes of every owner of the symbol table of the linked ELF; a change that moves the text or an owner by more than its tolerance moves the row in the same commit, with the reason in `measured`. An owner is the owner of the SYMBOL: code inlined at link time is counted under the symbol that carries it.

zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-28, scripts/kit-lane.sh build on the parity tree at origin's round 3826. The first reading of the owners, from the compare build of run 20261028T005644 (text 176,352), put the single-threaded zenoh-pico image's own code at about 55 KB against about 92 KB of wz's own (wz_session_core, c:wz_, wz_session_mcu, wz_codecs, sce_rust_runtime, wz_runtime_coop, keccak, core, compiler_builtins, wz_runtime_zephyr); the platform (the Zephyr network stack, the board's drivers, the toolchain) is the same size in both. The row first read 174,100 bytes with `keccak` at 2,164, the SHAKE128 permutation of the initial sequence number's derivation (src/initial_sn.rs), which zenoh-pico does not carry; with CONFIG_WZ_INITIAL_SN_COMPACT (this image's overlay turns it on) the permutation is not linked and the text was 171,692. With CONFIG_WZ_SUBSCRIBE=n (the overlay's too) the declaration of a subscriber and the registry that keeps the latest sample of each are not linked: 169,300, 2,392 bytes less, wz_session_core 2,006 of them, and 960 bytes less of bss. The reply writer now writes the responder's identity and an Err itself, so the codec's builder path (ResponseWriter::encode_generic and the heapless::Vec pushes of whole extension entries it makes) is not reachable and not linked when no build feature can stage a timestamp, an attachment or a source info: 167,148, 2,152 bytes less, wz_codecs 1,232 of them. The connect manager's `drive` and `ask` take the planner's call as a trait object, so each is one copy and not one for each of its thirteen callers: 164,488, 2,660 bytes less, c:wz_ (the main function with what it inlines) 2,618 of them. The session's link driver is named by its type (`SessionRuntime::Driver`, `SlotSink<D>`, `TxLease<D>`) where the image's Kconfig chose it, so the session's calls through the link are direct calls the compiler inlines and not calls through a trait object's table: 162,784, 1,704 bytes less (wz_session_core 922 of them). The receive hands a lent record to the sink's `record` and not to the one `event` that also carries the turn's own events, and the layers send a query or a put of their own only on the latter: 162,216, 568 bytes less (wz_runtime_coop 796 of them). The rows of the rounds that followed moved the text by less than the tolerance and were not moved with it; this row is the image of 2026-10-29: the connect manager's actions are one buffer that `drive` fills through `ask` and `take` reads in place, and its rows are put in the list's order in place and not taken out and built again (wz_session_mcu 1,068 bytes less), the peer entry is built as the call's result, and the session's parameters are made by the slot: 161,344 in all. 160,356 on 2026-10-29 with the node's set-up and its loop as two functions (`ClientNode::start`, inlined into the image's own `start`, and `RunningNode::drive`): the main function was 3,594 bytes and is 188, `c:wz_` (the main function with what it inlined) 3,748 bytes less, and the code it held is under its own owners now (wz_session_mcu 4,044 more, wz_zephyr_admin_node 1,228 new, wz_session_core 1,106 less and wz_runtime_coop 1,156 less, each of which the loop inlines into itself now that it is not one function with the set-up): 424 bytes less in all than the image before. 153,868 on 2026-10-29 with the receive of a Push and of a Response, a ResponseFinal not read (`rx-push`, `rx-response`): the client that only answers declares no subscriber and asks no query, so no router sends it those kinds; wz_session_core 4,044 bytes less and wz_codecs 2,386 less (the decoders only those kinds reached; which symbols was not listed), 6,488 bytes less in all, and 640 bytes of bss. 148,948 on 2026-10-29 with the control records of a peer not read either (`rx-control`: the Declare, the Interest and the Oam; this client sends no Interest, so a router declares nothing to it, and it holds no token and takes no session): wz_session_core 3,488 bytes less and wz_codecs 1,354 less, 4,920 bytes less in all. 147,772 on 2026-10-29 with the retry wait grown in integer arithmetic (`retry_period::grown_ms`: the soft-float multiply, the two conversions and the two comparisons of `(delay as f64 * factor) as u64` are not linked, compiler_builtins 1,238 bytes less and the integer code 558 more: 680 bytes less, within the tolerance and not moved then) and the endpoint text read in one byte scan (`dial::parse_endpoint` and `dial::decimal`, 886 bytes to 386: 496 bytes less). 147,556 on 2026-10-30 with the compiler runtime's `__aeabi_memclr` (208 bytes beside the libc `memset`) answered by `memset` (216 bytes less, within the tolerance and not moved then). 146,204 with the runtime taking no interrupt lock (`CONFIG_WZ_SINGLE_CONTEXT`, which this image's overlay turns on: the `irq_lock` and `irq_unlock` calls at about 130 borrows of the runtime's and the session's cells are not in the image; wz_session_core 506 bytes less, wz_session_mcu 678, wz_runtime_coop 144): 1,352 bytes less.
